title: A teleprompter that follows the speech
description: The scroll adjusts to the speaker, and the line you need can be brought back by hand.

blocks.text: Automatic scrolling is comfortable up to the first slip or background conversation. The speaker needs a quick way to bring back the line they need.

quote.text: It scrolls perfectly with your voice as you speak. You pause, it pauses. You go fast it goes fast.

blocks.text: Tie the position to the script, handle pauses separately and allow a manual correction. Keep a clear mode with a set speed.
Test a long speech with digressions and noise. Do not promise perfect recognition; control has to stay with the person speaking.
